objective: Keep setup.mjs as the CLI and workflow facade while moving the stable global projection-package handoff into explicit Application and Infrastructure boundaries without changing install or update behavior.

boundedVertical.name: stable_global_projection_package_handoff
boundedVertical.reasonForBoundary: The handoff must materialize the exact packed package into the immutable projection store before any persistent global execution reference is written.

setup: render localized progress and final status
retain no materialize, environment-sanitize, stable-child spawn, or authority verification algorithm
application: decide whether the current package is already a verified stable authority
delegate install or update to the stable package exactly once when required
merge rejected explicit managed-project results without changing their semantics
infrastructure: adapt the existing immutable projection-package store
spawn the stable setup child without a shell
verify package authority and write-boundary integrity
layerRules.dependencyDirection: setup composition root -> application use case + infrastructure adapter -> legacy store authority

deferred: install ownership or cleanup policy changes
